name: thought-scrapbook
description: Capture raw thoughts without polishing them away, then create separate refined drafts and links when requested.

interface.shortDescription: Capture raw thoughts without sanding off the weird parts
interface.longDescription: Store raw thoughts as immutable Markdown, keep refinement separate, and preserve links between ideas without replacing the original wording.
